verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a game engine, since comparable engines could ship one, so the axis applies. Bevy's evidence covers its ECS, rendering, platform support and community, but never mentions a built-in AI assistant. The runtime probe notes only nascent community tooling and no official MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
